chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan narrated to us, saying: Al-Husayn ibn al-Hasan ibn Aban narrated to us, from Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Al-Husayn ibn Ulwan, from 'Amr ibn Shimr, from Jabir, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) would, when he saw the crescent moon of the month of Ramadan, face the Qiblah with his face.

Then he would say: 'O Allah, bring it to us with security, faith, safety, Islam, encompassing health, abundant sustenance, prevention of diseases, recitation of the Quran, and assistance in prayer and fasting.'
O Allah, safeguard us for the month of Ramadan, safeguard it for us, and accept it from us until the month of Ramadan completes and You have forgiven us.

Then he would turn his face to the people and say: 'O assembly of Muslims! When the crescent of the month of Ramadan appears, the rebellious devils are shackled, the gates of heaven, the gates of Paradise, and the gates of Mercy are opened, and the gates of Hellfire are closed, and supplications are answered.'
And for Allah, at every Iftar, are freedmen whom He frees from the Hellfire. A caller calls out every night: 'Is there anyone who has a wish? Is there any seeker of forgiveness?'
O Allah! Reward everyone who spends in Your way and ruin the wealth of every miser.
Until the crescent of Shawwal appears, the believers are called out: 'Go forth to your rewards,' for it is the Day of Reward.
Then Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: 'By Him in Whose hand is my soul, it is not the day of receiving dinars and dirhams.'

key_terms.هِلَالُ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ: Crescent of the month of Ramadan

ai.seo_question: What is the supplication for sighting the Ramadan crescent and what are its spiritual benefits?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq records this tradition to highlight the Prophet’s (SAW) ritualistic greeting of Ramadan, emphasizing divine mercy through the shackling of devils and the opening of gates of Paradise. The narration concludes with a profound theological distinction: the ultimate 'reward' (Jaezah) for the believer is spiritual salvation rather than material wealth, a key concept in Shia eschatology. This practice underscores the communal and spiritual preparation for the month, linking physical fasting with spiritual liberation.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 2. Muhammad ibn al-Hasan narrated to us, saying: Al-Husayn b. al-Hasan b. Aban narrated to us, from al-Husayn b. Saʻeed, from al-Husayn b. ʻUlwan, from ʻAmr b.

Shimr, from Jabir, from Abu Jaʻfar (as) who said: The Messenger of Allah (SW), upon seeing the crescent moon of Ramadan, would turn towards the Qiblah and say: 
اللَّهُمَّ أَهِلَّهُ عَلَیْنَا بِالْأَمْنِ وَ الْإِیمَانِ وَ السَّلَامَهِ وَ الْإِسْلَامِ وَ الْعَافِیَهِ الْمُجَلِّلَهِ وَ الرِّزْقِ الْوَاسِعِ وَ دَفْعِ الْأَسْقَامِ وَ تِلَاوَهِ الْقُرْآنِ وَ الْعَوْنِ عَلَی الصَّلَاهِ وَ الصِّیَامِ اللَّهُمَّ سَلِّمْنَا لِشَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ وَ سَلِّمْهُ لَنَا وَ تَسَلَّمْهُ مِنَّا حَتَّی یَنْقَضِیَ شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ وَ قَدْ غَفَرْتَ لَنَا
"O Allah!
Let it bring us security, faith, safety, Islam, abundant sustenance, prevention of diseases, Quranic recitation, assistance in prayers and fasting.
O Allah! Safeguard us for the month of Ramadan, safeguard it for us, and accept it from us until the month of Ramadan completes and You forgive us.”

Then he would turn to the people and say: 'O Muslims! When the crescent of the month of Ramadan appears, the rebellious devils are shackled, the gates of heavens, the gates of Paradise, and the gates of Mercy are opened, and the gates of Hellfire are closed, and supplications are answered.
A large number of people are freed by Allah at the time of Iftar daily. A caller calls out every night, “Is there anyone who has a wish, Is there any seeker of forgiveness?
O Allah! Reward everyone who spends in Your way and ruin the wealth of every miser till the moon of the month of Shawwal appears.”
Abu Jaʻfar (as) said: "By Him in Whose hand is my soul, it is not the day of receiving the dinars and dirhams."
